sourceBindings.shippingDifference: Only && logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Error) in stderr's existing non-whitespace condition.
sourceBindings.rule: Future private source graphs only; never edit193 graphs or artifacts. Both prospective variants use byte-identical producer, consumer and dependencies. Read actual product assembly implementations; do not link copied reader/runner source into a replacement assembly.

fullInput.basis: Unamplified193 native producer data, not a captured npm/Angular/React transcript.
expectedNormalizedErrorMessagesWhenEnabl:
progressfirst error
plain {Value}
second error

tail
fullInput.partialChunkGate: Wait for real OnReceivedChunk accumulation equal to progress before sending lines.
fullInput.completeLineGate: Wait for the actual raw OnReceivedLine value ESC[0m followed by LF before sending finish.
fullInput.rule: No loop, repeat/count option, longer text, added stderr marker, flushing delay or larger output. Retain the existing command-driven one-process producer.

whitespaceInput.onFinish: End stderr without a tail, then close readline and stdin.
whitespaceInput.partialChunkGate: Wait for actual accumulated space+tab chunk data before sending lines.
whitespaceInput.completeLineGate: Wait for the actual empty LF line after the whitespace CRLF line before sending finish.
whitespaceInput.rule: Use whitespace itself as the producer gate. Do not add a non-whitespace/ANSI stderr sentinel, which would invalidate this zero-normalization control.

loggingAndAssertions.factory: Use the real LoggerFactory category Microsoft.AspNetCore.SpaServices and the existing TestLoggerProvider/TestSink, with the selected real minimum-level filter.
loggingAndAssertions.loggerPassedToAttachToLogger: The actual factory.CreateLogger result directly; NOT193 RecordingLogger.
loggingAndAssertions.whyNoRecordingLogger: 193's diagnostic wrapper eagerly formats/enqueues rejected attempts before forwarding. Timing that wrapper would charge synthetic rejected-log recording to the baseline and exaggerate the guard's benefit.
loggingAndAssertions.rawCapture: Keep production EventedStreamStringReader attached independently. Its expected string is each received raw line plus Environment.NewLine, including the final unterminated tail.
loggingAndAssertions.console: Retain the same per-operation partial-chunk Console capture for both variants; no globally parallel operation. Do not assume newline-containing OS chunk partitioning is stable.
loggingAndAssertions.expectedSink: Full Error emits exactly the five normalized Error messages; Critical/None emit none. Whitespace emits no Error messages at any level. Information/stdout messages are filtered at all three measured levels.
loggingAndAssertions.completion: Await actual Node exit0, both production stream-closed events and all callbacks/drains. Dispose logger/provider, runner and Process before consumer exit0. Preserve literal braces, color stripping, CRLF/LF, ANSI-only newline and raw error diagnostics.
loggingAndAssertions.outsideInterval: Supervisor result parsing, byte/identity comparison and statistical calculations. Consumer logging, collection, required callback delivery and flushing remain inside the whole-operation interval.

futureConsumerAndIdentityPlan.readiness: No runnable source supplied because workload/materiality and image prerequisites remain open.
futureConsumerAndIdentityPlan.consumer: Prefer a private executable entrypoint/build mode inside the existing native test project, preserving its assembly name and existing product access. A selected case performs exactly one real NodeScriptRunner operation. Build-mode qualification is still required; no new framework IVT/UnsafeAccessor or standalone copied product implementation.
futureConsumerAndIdentityPlan.managedIdentity: An explicitly authorized untimed run of each frozen image must report actual Environment.Version, RuntimeInformation.FrameworkDescription, runtime directory, loaded CoreLib/coreclr paths and hashes, product assembly path/hash/MVID, process architecture, deps/runtimeconfig hashes and physical-host witness. Original must actually load26562.105; Default must separately load26569.107. Refuse roll-forward or fallback.
futureConsumerAndIdentityPlan.nodeIdentity: A future explicit identity-only stdin command may report the actual child process.pid, process.execPath and process.versions.node/v8 on stdout during untimed qualification. Resolve/hash that exact executable and capture its owned PID/ancestry. Never send that command in measured cases or add identity stderr output.
futureConsumerAndIdentityPlan.executableBinding: Bind package-manager command/path and PATH to the same frozen Node executable for both variants; qualify Windows cmd quoting and actual Node child selection before timing. A path label alone is insufficient.
futureConsumerAndIdentityPlan.entryInvocation: Future child uses graph activation and the explicit frozen runtime/deps files, exact --fx-version and --roll-forward Disable where supported. Verify the actual consumer runtime, not merely dotnet --info, SDK metadata or parent launcher version.
futureConsumerAndIdentityPlan.imageManifest: For each role/variant freeze all source inputs, program/producer/provider DLLs, PDB/MVIDs, deps/runtimeconfig, host/SDK/runtime closures, Node, scripts, argv, working directory and environment hashes before timing. Outputs go outside immutable images. Consumers and Node inputs must match across each pair.
futureConsumerAndIdentityPlan.processSettings: Preserve exact graph activation plus DOTNET_GENERATE_ASPNET_CERTIFICATE=false, DOTNET_ADD_GLOBAL_TOOLS_TO_PATH=false and MSBUILDDISABLENODEREUSE=1. Use the unmodified common helper's declared tiering0 settings for both variants if the coordinator accepts that limitation. No machine priority/affinity/power changes.
futureConsumerAndIdentityPlan.failurePolicy: Identity/setup/case faults do not become performance samples or permission to retune. Preserve failed attempts; no automatic rerun. No future process launch is authorized by this source plan.
